gscBaselineRange.note: Finalized Search Console planning range. New changes must be evaluated only after enough post-change finalized data exists.

decisionRules.successRule: Scale a tactic only when post-change GSC evidence shows meaningful improvement in the intended query/page relationship without creating cannibalization or quality/audit failures.
decisionRules.failureRule: If a tactic has enough impressions to evaluate and does not improve the intended signal, do not roll it out broadly. Reassess or revert where appropriate.

evidence: General Rancho page and refrigerator/freezer specialty pages are appearing for generic appliance-pickup queries.
Our Rancho cluster already has more dedicated specialty pages than the competitor's discoverable Rancho cluster, so more pages are not the first intervention.
TakeMyAppliance repeatedly ranks with one strong city page plus broader site-level topical and external authority.
experiments.hypothesis: Concentrating broad Rancho intent on the main city page, avoiding further specialty-page expansion, strengthening contextual internal support, and building real external brand mentions will improve the main page's generic appliance-pickup visibility.
actions: Do not create additional Rancho specialty pages during the test window.
Increase contextual links to the main Rancho page from relevant regional, qualification, commercial and appliance-guide pages using descriptive broad-intent anchors.
Pursue legitimate third-party brand mentions/citations relevant to appliance pickup, reuse, property management and local service; do not buy or spam links.
Track generic Rancho query-to-page concentration in GSC.

experiments.hypothesis: A conversion/snippet and intent-focus improvement on the existing Fresno general page can convert page-one/near-page-one visibility without adding more city pages.
actions: Keep the general page as owner of broad appliance pickup/removal/recycling intent.
Keep washer/dryer-only intent on the dedicated laundry page.
Test stronger search-result promise and trust wording only when metadata remains accurate.
Build local third-party mentions and partner references where legitimate.

queryEvidence.query: appliance pick up free near me

experiments.hypothesis: Denver has some near-page-one query signals but weak page-level average performance; strengthening city-specific intent concentration and real Colorado authority/mentions should outperform adding generic text.
actions: Avoid expanding into unsupported city-by-appliance pages until a specific query proves demand.
Strengthen legitimate Denver/Colorado citations, partner mentions and relevant external references.
Measure query-to-page concentration and city-query movement.

experiments.hypothesis: Protect a page-one signal and use it as a control; avoid major rewrites while testing broader site changes.
actions: No major content rewrite unless GSC shows deterioration or a clear query gap.

experiments.hypothesis: Protect current page-one performance while other market experiments run.
actions: No major rewrite; make only technical corrections or strongly supported CTR fixes.

experiments.hypothesis: Protect a strong regional-hub signal and use it as evidence that the hub architecture can work.
actions: Preserve intent ownership and strengthen only with proven internal/supporting signals.
